children: Oil futures decline in the Asian session, likely due to a technical correction after gains on Thursday. Oil prices had likely been driven higher by supply disruption concerns following deadly Houthi attacks on a Saudi Aramco facility and an airport in eastern Saudi Arabia, says UOB's Global Economics & Markets Research team in a note. Front-month WTI crude-oil futures slip 0.3% to $99.16 a barrel, while front-month Brent eases 0.3% to $112.79 a barrel, ICE data show. (megan.cheah@wsj.com)
